disease_actions.Tomato___Early_blight: Remove affected leaves and improve airflow. Apply an appropriate fungicide if the infection is spreading.
disease_actions.Tomato___Late_blight: Remove infected plant material and avoid overhead watering. Use an appropriate fungicide when necessary.
disease_actions.Tomato___healthy: Plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring and proper watering.
disease_actions.Potato___Early_blight: Remove affected leaves and maintain good field sanitation. Consider an appropriate fungicide if needed.
disease_actions.Potato___Late_blight: Remove infected material quickly and avoid overhead irrigation. Apply appropriate disease control measures.

disease_actions.Pepper,_bell___healthy: Plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring.
disease_actions.Apple___Apple_scab: Remove infected leaves and fruit debris and improve airflow. Use appropriate fungicide management if needed.
disease_actions.Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew: Prune for better air circulation and apply a sulfur-based fungicide. Avoid overhead watering.
disease_actions.Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy: Plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring and proper watering.
disease_actions.Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_: Apply a fungicide if rust pustules are spreading. Rotate crops next season to reduce recurrence.
disease_actions.Corn_(maize)___healthy: Plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring and proper watering.
disease_actions.Grape___Black_rot: Remove infected fruit and leaves immediately. Apply fungicide during wet periods and improve canopy airflow.
disease_actions.Grape___healthy: Plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring and proper watering.
disease_actions.Peach___Bacterial_spot: Remove and destroy infected leaves/fruit. Apply copper-based bactericide during dormant season.
disease_actions.Peach___healthy: Plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring and proper watering.
disease_actions.Potato___healthy: Plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring and proper watering.
disease_actions.Squash___Powdery_mildew: Apply sulfur or potassium bicarbonate fungicide. Improve spacing for airflow and avoid overhead watering.
disease_actions.Strawberry___Leaf_scorch: Remove infected leaves and avoid overhead irrigation. Apply fungicide if spreading persists.
disease_actions.Strawberry___healthy: Plant appears healthy. Continue regular monitoring and proper watering.
disease_actions.Tomato___Bacterial_spot: Remove infected leaves, avoid overhead watering, and apply copper-based bactericide.
disease_actions.Tomato___Leaf_Mold: Improve greenhouse/field ventilation and reduce humidity. Apply fungicide if infection persists.
disease_actions.Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot: Remove affected lower leaves and apply fungicide. Avoid wetting foliage when watering.
disease_actions.Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider: Apply miticide or insecticidal soap. Increase humidity around plants to discourage mites.
disease_actions.Tomato___Target_Spot: Remove infected leaves and apply fungicide. Ensure adequate plant spacing for airflow.
disease_actions.Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus: Remove and destroy infected plants. Control whitefly populations, the primary vector, using insecticide or sticky traps.
disease_actions.Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus: Remove and destroy infected plants immediately. Disinfect tools and avoid handling healthy plants after infected ones.
disease_actions.Bacterialblight: Drain excess water from the field and apply a copper hydroxide or streptomycin spray. Avoid excessive nitrogen application.
disease_actions.Rice___Bacterialblight: Drain excess water from the field and apply a copper hydroxide or streptomycin spray. Avoid excessive nitrogen application.
disease_actions.Blast: Apply tricyclazole or isoprothiolane at earliest symptom appearance. Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization.
disease_actions.Rice___Blast: Apply tricyclazole or isoprothiolane at earliest symptom appearance. Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization.
disease_actions.Brownspot: Ensure balanced soil nutrition with adequate potassium. Apply mancozeb or propiconazole if leaf spotting spreads.
disease_actions.Rice___Brownspot: Ensure balanced soil nutrition with adequate potassium. Apply mancozeb or propiconazole if leaf spotting spreads.
disease_actions.Tungro: Control green leafhopper vectors with recommended insecticides and rogue out severely infected plants.
disease_actions.Rice___Tungro: Control green leafhopper vectors with recommended insecticides and rogue out severely infected plants.
disease_actions.Sugarcane___healthy: Plant appears healthy. Continue regular irrigation and scheduled nutrient management.
disease_actions.Sugarcane___Mosaic: Rogue out infected clumps and manage aphid vectors to prevent secondary virus transmission.
disease_actions.Sugarcane___RedRot: Uproot and burn diseased stalks immediately. Do not ratoon infected crops and ensure proper drainage.
disease_actions.Sugarcane___Rust: Apply protective triazole or mancozeb fungicide. Ensure adequate plant spacing to improve ventilation.
disease_actions.Sugarcane___Yellow: Manage sucking pests like whiteflies and aphids. Plant virus-free certified setts.
disease_actions.Alternaria_Leaf: Apply mancozeb or copper oxychloride fungicide at first sign of leaf spots. Maintain proper plant spacing.
disease_actions.Cotton___Alternaria_Leaf: Apply mancozeb or copper oxychloride fungicide at first sign of leaf spots. Maintain proper plant spacing.
disease_actions.Bacterial_Blight: Apply copper oxychloride combined with streptocycline. Avoid overhead irrigation to minimize bacterial spread.
disease_actions.Cotton___Bacterial_Blight: Apply copper oxychloride combined with streptocycline. Avoid overhead irrigation to minimize bacterial spread.
disease_actions.Fusarium_Wilt: Drench soil around infected plants with carbendazim and rogue out severely wilted plants to protect field.
disease_actions.Cotton___Fusarium_Wilt: Drench soil around infected plants with carbendazim and rogue out severely wilted plants to protect field.
disease_actions.Healthy_Leaf: Plant foliage appears healthy. Continue balanced crop nutrition and routine pest scouting.
disease_actions.Cotton___Healthy_Leaf: Plant foliage appears healthy. Continue balanced crop nutrition and routine pest scouting.
disease_actions.Verticillium_Wilt: Remove diseased plants, avoid excessive irrigation, and practice long rotation with non-host crops.
disease_actions.Cotton___Verticillium_Wilt: Remove diseased plants, avoid excessive irrigation, and practice long rotation with non-host crops.
disease_actions.Soybean___Bacterial_leaf_Blight: Apply copper-based bactericide. Avoid field operations while foliage is wet to prevent bacterial transfer.
disease_actions.Soybean___healthy: Soybean crop appears healthy. Maintain regular weed management and scheduled field scouting.
disease_actions.Soybean___Septoria_Brown_Spot: Apply strobilurin or triazole fungicide if lesions advance into the mid-canopy during pod fill.
disease_actions.Soybean___Vein_Necrosis: Rogue out infected plants and monitor viral transmission vectors in the field.
disease_actions.Wheat Brown rust: Apply propiconazole or tebuconazole at first appearance of orange-brown pustules on wheat leaves.
disease_actions.Wheat___Brown_rust: Apply propiconazole or tebuconazole at first appearance of orange-brown pustules on wheat leaves.

disease_actions.Wheat___Healthy: Wheat crop appears healthy. Continue scheduled irrigation and monitor for foliar symptoms.

disease_actions.Wheat___Loose_Smut: Carefully remove and destroy infected black smutted ears in polythene bags. Use certified treated seed for future sowing.
disease_actions.Wheat Yellow rust: Apply propiconazole 25 EC or azoxystrobin immediately to prevent rapid stripe rust spread across the canopy.
disease_actions.Wheat___Yellow_rust: Apply propiconazole 25 EC or azoxystrobin immediately to prevent rapid stripe rust spread across the canopy.
disease_actions.Anthracnose and Red Rot: Apply mancozeb or carbendazim foliar spray and avoid waterlogging around crop root zones.
disease_actions.Jowar___Anthracnose_and_Red_Rot: Apply mancozeb or carbendazim foliar spray and avoid waterlogging around crop root zones.

disease_actions.Jowar___Cereal_Grain_molds: Harvest promptly at physiological maturity and apply protective fungicide if rains occur during grain development.

disease_actions.Jowar___Covered_Kernel_smut: Remove and destroy smutted heads before threshing. Always practice seed treatment with sulfur or thiram.

disease_actions.Jowar___Head_Smut: Rogue out smutted galls before fungal spores burst into the air. Practice crop rotation.

disease_actions.Jowar___Rust: Apply foliar mancozeb spray if rust pustules emerge before heading.

disease_actions.Bajra___Downy_Mildew: Rogue out infected green-ear plants and apply metalaxyl-mancozeb fungicide spray.

disease_actions.Bajra___Exserohilum_Leaf_Blight: Apply mancozeb or zineb fungicide at early leaf spot stage to protect foliage.

disease_actions.Bajra___Healthy: Crop appears healthy. Continue balanced fertilization and regular field scouting.

pest_actions.aphids: Inspect new growth and leaf undersides. Use physical removal or an appropriate pest-control method if infestation increases.
pest_actions.Thrips: Inspect flowers and young leaves. Remove heavily affected material and use appropriate integrated pest management.
pest_actions.corn borer: Inspect stems for entry holes and larvae. Remove severely affected plants and use appropriate pest management.
pest_actions.army worm: Inspect leaves for feeding damage and larvae. Remove visible larvae and use appropriate pest management if infestation increases.
pest_actions.peach borer: Inspect stems and trunk areas for borer damage. Remove affected material and use appropriate pest management.
pest_actions.flea beetle: Monitor leaf damage and use appropriate integrated pest management if damage becomes significant.
